name: Atlas
lead: Corporate ownership and regulatory relationships mapped with source-graded confidence — so a confirmed fact never reads like an assumption.
architecture: Atlas builds a graph of corporate entities, ownership, control and regulatory relationships. The point is not the graph — it is that every edge carries a confidence grade and the source that supports it.
A confirmed filing and an inferred link render differently and are queryable separately. An analyst can ask for "only what is documented" and get an answer they can put in front of a regulator.
The extraction path is the same source-grounded pipeline as UW and FNOL, pointed at filings, registries and disclosures instead of submissions.
